## Workflow package

This release contains the three public FLUX.2 Klein 9B workflows:

- `hoi4_portrait_flux2_klein_9b_source` — the identity-preserving source-photo
  workflow, with optional restoration and final background replacement. One
  source run creates three independent final candidates. The default LoRA
  strength is `0.7`.
- `hoi4_portrait_flux2_klein_9b_text_to_image` — fictional portrait generation
  without a source photo.
- `hoi4_portrait_processing_only` — source preparation before final styling.

Each workflow is supplied in editor and API formats. The package contains no
model weights.

## Installation

- Use the model-free ZIP on any supported local ComfyUI or RunPod setup.
- Use the Windows x64 self-extractor to unpack the same package, then follow
  `docs/local-install.md`.

The RunPod and Windows scripts install the three workflows, the six pinned
model files, the sample input, and the bundled backgrounds. The FLUX.2 Klein
base model remains gated by its upstream license and Hugging Face agreement.

## RunPod

On a RunPod image that already contains ComfyUI:

```bash
export HF_TOKEN="hf_..."
P=/workspace/comfyui-hoi4-portraits
COMFY_ROOT=/workspace/runpod-slim/ComfyUI
test -f "$COMFY_ROOT/main.py" || { echo "ComfyUI not found at $COMFY_ROOT; set COMFY_ROOT to the folder containing main.py."; exit 1; }
test -d "$P/.git" || git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/klimPaskov/comfyui-hoi4-portraits.git "$P"
"$P/scripts/install_runpod.sh" "$COMFY_ROOT"
"$P/scripts/start_runpod.sh" "$COMFY_ROOT"
```

The installer verifies all six model files before finishing. Keep the token in
the pod environment; it is not written to the project. Confirm that
`COMFY_ROOT` points to the folder containing `main.py` before installation.

The older Krea workflows remain available as an archived alternative in the
[v1.0.0 release](https://github.com/klimPaskov/comfyui-hoi4-portraits/releases/tag/v1.0.0).
